data.narrative:
NVision Imaging Technologies is a Series A biotech company founded by Martin Plenio, Ilai Schwartz, Fedor Jelezko, Alex Retzker, and Sella Brosh. The company has raised $20M to date. The broader biotech and health sector includes 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods examined, only stage-progression analysis was applicable. Using total capital raised of $20M as a proxy for enterprise value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to next-stage financings yields an implied valuation of $40M. Peer-median triangulation could not be applied due to insufficient narrow-stage comparable data—while 8 same-sector private companies exist, only 1 fell into adjacent-stage buckets, below the threshold of 3 required for statistical credibility. Public-comp anchoring using the sector P/S median of 5.5x across the three public tickers was inapplicable, as NVision's revenue is not disclosed.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $34M (low) to $46M (high), with a median point of $40M. This range reflects modest upside from capital deployed. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue-based metrics for the target, limited private peer comparability at this specific stage, and the reliance on a single methodological pillar. Revenue generation trajectory and competitive positioning within frontier imaging applications will be material refiners of this estimate.
